changelog: Custom shortcut icons are no longer cropped by icon packs, and unmatched icons and shortcuts follow the theme scale. Theme, dock, effects, and gesture buttons can be added to the desktop again. Full-screen gesture back no longer opens the app under the finger. The gallery widget opens photos with the system default app. The gallery plugin version is unchanged; uninstall it and install it again to use the new open behavior.
changelogZh: 自定义快捷方式图标不再被图标包裁切，未适配图标和快捷方式跟随主题缩放。主题、停靠栏、效果、手势可以重新加到桌面。全面屏手势返回时不再误打开手指下的应用。相册小部件点击照片按系统默认应用打开。相册插件版本号未变，要使用新的打开方式请先卸载再安装。
